leaf.text: If one of the leaf 2 output descriptors is "0xfe", then leaf 2 does not report any TLB data and this leaf should be used for enumerating TLB and other address translation parameters.

subleaf.desc: Deterministic address translation parameters info structure #n, n = subleaf index
subleaf.text: Client code should iterate from subleaf 0 until @tlb_max_subleaf is reached. One or more of the subleaves m, m ≤ @tlb_max_subleaf, can still be invalid (@tlb_type = 0). For subleaves n, n > 0, @tlb_max_subleaf field is reserved.

bit8.desc: (Hard/Soft) partitioning between logical CPUs sharing this structure

value.desc: Load-only TLB (hit on loads; fill on loads/stores)
Store-only TLB (hit on stores; fill on stores)

bit14.desc: Max number of addressable IDs for logical CPUs sharing this TLB - 1
